repos.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
repos.readme_excerpt:
# Auto Ontology

Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own.

It enables developers to:

• Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs.

• Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems.

# 闲鱼智能监控系统

基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控，提供完整的 Web 管理界面。

# 核心特性

• Web 可视化管理: 任务管理、账号管理、AI 标准编辑、运行日志、结果浏览

• AI 驱动: 自然语言创建任务，多模态模型深度分析商品

• 多任务并发: 独立配置关键词、价格、筛选条件和 AI Prompt

• 高级筛选: 包邮、新发布时间范围、省/市/区三级区域筛选

• 即时通知: 支持 ntfy.sh、企业微信、Bark、Telegram、Webhook等多渠道

• 定时调度: 支持 Cron 配置周期性任务

• 账号与代理轮换: 多账号管理、任务绑定账号、代理池轮换与失败重试

# 截图

# 🐳 Docker 部署（推荐）

如果镜像无法访问或下载速度慢，可尝试使用加速：

• Docker 镜像已内置 Chromium，无需宿主机额外安装浏览器。

• 如果你修改了 .env 中的 SERVER_PORT，请同步更新 docker-compose.yaml 里的端口映射。

• docker-compose.yaml 默认会把 SQLite 主库挂载到 ./data:/app/data，数据库文件默认为 data/app.sqlite3

• images/ 商品图片与任务临时图片目录

• config.json、jsonl/、price_history/ 首次升级到 SQLite 时用于兼容导入的旧数据源

# 数据存储与迁移

• 当前在线主存储为 SQLite，默认路径 data/app.sqlite3

• 可通过环境变量 APP_DATABASE_FILE 自定义数据库路径；Docker 默认设置为 /app/data/app.sqlite3

• 应用启动时会自动建库建表，并尝试从旧的 config.json、jsonl/、price_history/ 导入一次历史数据

• state/、prompts/、logs/、images/ 仍然是文件系统目录，不在 SQLite 中

• 商品图片会临时落到 images/task_images_ /，任务结束后默认会清理

repos.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
repos.readme_excerpt:
# agent-desktop

Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library.

Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads.

# Install

Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from GitHub Releases and keep its helper beside the executable.

LZ4 - Extremely fast compression

LZ4 is a lossless compression algorithm, providing compression speed > 500 MB/s per core, scalable with multi-core CPUs. It features an extremely fast decoder, with speed in multiple GB/s per core, typically reaching RAM speed limits on multi-core systems.

Compression speed can be tuned dynamically, by selecting an "acceleration" factor which trades compression ratio for faster speed. On the other end, a high compression derivative, LZ4_HC, is also provided, trading CPU time for improved compression ratio. All versions feature the same decompression speed.

LZ4 is also compatible with dictionary compression, both at API and CLI (-D) levels. It can ingest any input file as dictionary, though only the final 64 KB are used. This capability can be combined with the Zstandard Dictionary Builder, in order to drastically improve compression performance on small files.

repos.readme_excerpt:
# agent-browser

Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell.

agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call.

# Install

• Homebrew: brew install agent-browser, then agent-browser install.

• Linux: agent-browser install --with-deps also installs the browser's system libraries.

• No install: npx agent-browser open example.com.

Project installs, building from source, upgrade, and doctor are covered in Installation.

# Quick start

The snapshot for example.com:

• Refs describe the page at the time of the snapshot. After navigation or a DOM change, take a new snapshot before using refs again.

# motion-showreel

Category: Motion Graphics / Code Video

Best for: showreels, product films, UI motion, kinetic typography, logo/title sequences, generative loops, retrospectives and narrated explainers. Short pieces typically run 5–60 s; chapter-based films support up to 20 minutes.

motion-showreel delivers MP4 plus editable source. It confirms the topic, duration, orientation, independent music/SFX sources and narration mode, then writes a brief and confirms style frames. Deterministic render(t) pages are captured frame by frame on a shared audio/picture timeline. Narration follows a user-supplied script or recording; pictures follow actual speech timings. Long films use persistent chapter caches and technical acceptance.

# What is Floci?

Floci is a free, open-source local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI.

It gives you AWS-shaped services on your machine without requiring a cloud account, an auth token, or paid feature gates. Point your AWS SDK, CLI, Terraform, CDK, OpenTofu, or test suite at http://localhost:4566 and keep your existing workflows.

Already using LocalStack? Floci is a drop-in replacement: swap the image and keep going. See Migrating from LocalStack.

Floci is the AWS member of the Floci emulator family, named after floccus, the cloud formation that looks like popcorn.

# Quick Start

repos.readme_excerpt:
全能的光盘盘面可见图像生成与刻录工具

Disc Image Studio 是一个多平台的光盘盘面图像生成与刻录工具，帮助您使用任何刻录光驱在任何 DVD / CD / 单层蓝光 光盘上刻蚀出肉眼可见的图像。

# 效果预览

# 概述

Disc Image Studio 可将一张图片转换成符合 CD、DVD 与单层 BD-R 光盘物理层约束的数据，刻录后将使光盘盘面呈现肉眼可见的图案。

# 界面预览

# 快速开始

Windows 下载 win-x64.exe 后可直接运行。Linux 或 macOS 请下载与 CPU 匹配的实验性 CLI 压缩包，解压后运行 ./disc-image-studio --help。这些发布包均自带 .NET 运行时。 GitHub Releases

# 1. 新建工程

在主页选择 CD、DVD 或蓝光，指定输出位置后创建工程。

# 2. 设计盘面

在设计页导入图片，用图层完成排版，并在右栏「影调」模块调整抖动、伽马、亮度与灰阶档位。

# 3. 预览与导出

在预览页核对盘面投影，在导出页生成 ISO / RAW / WAV+CUE，或使用即时刻录功能直接写入空白盘片。

即时刻录为实验性功能，请只使用可报废的测试介质。

# 功能

# 光盘数据生成

• CD 支持：支持任何 CD 。您可导出带格式头的 WAV 音轨及配套 CUE，兼容 cdrecord, ImgBurn等刻录软件；也允许导出 RAW 音轨。详见 CD 刻录兼容说明。

• DVD 支持：支持任何 DVD。您可导出 ISO 镜像。

• 蓝光支持：支持任何单层 BD-R 25 GB，支持纯绘图与 UDF 2.01 文件。详见 ADDING_BLURAY.md。

• 随盘文件：CD／DVD／蓝光可在设计页直接选择要保存的文件夹及内圈／外圈位置，也可在导出页调整；设置随工程保存。

• 文件区域预览：混合盘的设计投影和成品读回用黄色标出文件区（含文件系统）。

• 介质灰度方案：CD 与 DVD 均使用黑白二阶，CD 使用 0D / AA，DVD 扰码域使用 A5 / 92。详见 PHYSICAL_MODEL_AUDIT.md。
